prompt_en: Create a photorealistic editorial performance photograph of the Mirror Gong Laboratory on a controlled matte-black optical-calibration stage. Show one unmistakably adult performance artist beside a waist-high circular frame holding a tensioned mirror-finish metallized-PET membrane, frozen at one decisive open-palm strike at the membrane's center. The palm is visibly in contact; a shallow dimple and concentric ripples distort nested strip-light bands. The performer's visible adult face, facial features, complexion, and hair length, color, texture, and part follow the attached appearance reference. Frame a three-quarter medium-wide view at membrane height with a 50 mm lens and brief flash duration, keeping face, hand, contact dimple, membrane, and chrome supports sharp. A concealed rear strip makes the membrane rim a narrow high-luminance crescent. Use muted filmic color and localized highlight behavior: one or more genuinely high-luminance edges anchor the effect; a thin warm or red-biased halo sits immediately outside those edges; halo width and intensity fall off locally rather than covering the frame; highlight core shape and adjacent nonhighlight detail remain readable; aligned ghost orbs broad veiling haze and chromatic edge pairs remain visibly distinct from the thin local halo.
